title: Omnipod Dash not working with 3.3.2.1 and latest pixel 10 pro update (September 5.)
body: Hi, I got a notification today that the latest Pixel 10 Pro updates where ready to install. (Unfortunately) I installed the update. Since then, I am constantly loosing connection to the Pod after about 10minutes. Restarting the phone helps, but only for another short period, before the connection is lost again. I tried to use the Android15 workaround to Bond the bluetooth device, with no success. Instead of silently loosing connection, I now get the following popup. It repeats, claiming incorrect key. Any suggestions what to do?

comments.body: I mean, I am willing to help but would need some pointers where to start
